_what: The CI test job, run locally by `npm run verify` (scripts/ci/verify.mjs), in CI's order. scripts/__tests__/verify-steps.test.ts fails unless every `run:` step of jobs.test in .github/workflows/test.yml is listed here, either under `run` (same name, same command, same continue-on-error) or under `skip` with a reason. A step the workflow gains turns that test red until this file learns it.

run.name: Check coverage scope (test-support excluded, product included)

skip.name: Check required environment variables
skip.why: Needs CI's secrets (GOOGLE_CLIENT_*, CRON_SECRET, UPSTASH_*, SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY...). Run locally it would check your .env, not CI's, and a pass would mean nothing about CI.
